title: Broccoli and butter bean bake with walnut crumb

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain whole food or a simple staple such as tinned beans, crème fraîche, breadcrumbs and cheese, with nothing factory-built.

supermarket.reason: Broccoli, cherry tomatoes, tinned butter beans, crème fraîche, walnuts and vegetarian hard cheese are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, knife, board and grater, and the technique is simply tossing everything together and baking.

works.reason: Two heads of broccoli and two tins of beans in crème fraîche under a crumb, baked for 25 minutes at 200°C, gives a properly cooked, well-seasoned bake that feeds four.

honest_times.reason: Cutting the broccoli, slicing the garlic, zesting, picking the thyme, chopping the walnuts and grating the cheese fit in 15 minutes, and the 25-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon zest and juice and the thyme, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Broccoli is the bulk and point of the dish, and a quick vegetable bake with lemon and cherry tomatoes is reasonable for a late June evening.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner can follow, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Plenty of vegetables, beans for protein and a cheesy walnut crumb make a filling family dinner people would happily cook again.
